commands:
set -euo pipefail
echo '=== CANDIDATE HEAD ==='
git status --short --branch
git log -1 --oneline --decorate
echo
echo '=== MERGE-TREE MAIN + DEVELOP ==='
if git merge-tree --write-tree HEAD origin/develop >/tmp/photomap-merge-tree.out 2>/tmp/photomap-merge-tree.err; then
  echo 'merge_tree_status=clean'
  cat /tmp/photomap-merge-tree.out
else
  code=$?
  echo "merge_tree_status=conflict exit=$code"
  cat /tmp/photomap-merge-tree.out || true
  cat /tmp/photomap-merge-tree.err || true
fi
